name: sharea-verify
description: Sharea (شارع) — universal verified-location landing page. Material 3 Expressive via shadcn M3E.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr --emptyOutDir && node scripts/ssg.mjs && node scripts/preload-fonts.mjs --base=/
scripts.build:sandbox: tsc -b && vite build --base=/site/ && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr --emptyOutDir && node scripts/ssg.mjs && node scripts/preload-fonts.mjs --base=/site/
scripts.build:pages: tsc -b && vite build --base=/sharea-landing-page/ && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr --emptyOutDir && node scripts/ssg.mjs && node scripts/preload-fonts.mjs --base=/sharea-landing-page/
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
